title: Terminal workflow: discover, create and test a datasource, publish, query, propose, see API-key approval refused, approve as a person, unpublish
promise: An operator runs the whole publication workflow from the installed command-line clients. The proposal comes from the agent surface (the installed MCP proxy, as in the terminal journey). The typed approval command cannot approve with an API key: the proposer's own key and the approver's admin:approve key are both refused with 403, the latter with the server's human-approval refusal. A person approves in a Console password session, and the command-line client then reads the resolved proposal and the published layer. The server's state after every command matches the fixture.

steps.description: List the published services; the fixture's sites service is listed.
Create a PostGIS datasource for the fixture database.
Test the stored datasource; the connection is healthy.
Publish the client's lifecycle table as a new service and layer.
List the datasource's layers for the service; the published layer is enabled.
Query the sites layer with the fixture filter; the features equal the filtered fixture rows with exact ordinates.
Count the published lifecycle layer's features; the count is the number of fixture rows.

As the proposer principal, find honua_publish_service in the setup view and call it to publish the client's proposal table; the server records a proposal awaiting approval instead of publishing, and the proposed service is not served (honua layers: 404 or no layers) until approval.
The proposer tries to approve its own proposal; the command fails with 403 and the proposal is still awaiting approval.

The approver principal tries to approve with its admin:approve API key through the typed approval command; the command fails with the server's 403 that requires a live interactive browser session, and the proposal is still awaiting approval.
A person approves the proposal in a Console password session over HTTPS: approval review, then approve with the review capability. The server records the console-interactive-password channel.
Read the proposal until its status is terminal (bounded deadline): it succeeded, was requested by the proposer and resolved by the person's Console session.
Query the layer the approval published; the features equal the proposal fixture rows with exact ordinates.
Query the unpublished layer; the command fails with not found (404).

honua-sdk-js.approve: Console password session: open approval-review, approve with the review capability (e2e/harness/lib/human_approval.py)
honua-sdk-js.proposal-resolved: honua admin operate getOperationProposal --profile approver (until terminal)

honua-sdk-python-wheel.approve: Console password session: open approval-review, approve with the review capability (e2e/harness/lib/human_approval.py)
